text_block_list.text:
A day off――I was planning on heading out 
somewhere when I spotted Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
『Good morning, Victory~♪ 
Salutations, Full of energy,
Today's also A-okay~♪』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Hello! Today,
I was thinking of going 
to a place I've been interested in for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……Ah,
that's right! If it's okay with you, 
Trainer-san, how about coming with me?

I wanted to understand more about Sakura 
Laurel so I decided to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's a beautiful church,
isn't it? The architecture here 
incorporates many elements associated with
France, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I found it while searching the net! 
I knew I definitely had to come see it in
person.

Sakura Laurel had a strong admiration and
dream that was 
related to France.
Was this church also a part of that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ! ……Fufufuu♪ I'm glad you asked!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
First, this stained glass! 
It's a characteristic of the Gothic
architectural style!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Tall ceilings with large windows to let in
a lot of light―― 
That's what this style was developed for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Outside,
there are gargoyles!
They're an unusual design 
that actually functions as a rain gutter♪
And also――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
this place looks a little similar to 
the church where my parents got married.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In my room,
I've got a bunch of photos of those 
memories on my walls……and among those,
is a photo of 
my parents walking down the aisle for their
wedding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at it,
I can't help but feel all warm inside――
choice_data_list: That's why you wanted to see it in...
That's why you wanted to see it in...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This altar too…… 
yeah, it really looks similar.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……――That's right! Hey, Trainer-san. 
Want to try walking it together?

Before I could say anything,
Sakura Laurel linked 
arms with me and pulled me along.
Almost like she 
was re-enacting the last part of a
wedding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? At the end,
when the Bride and Groom walk together,
it's to symbolize that 
they'll be walking their 『Future』
together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even if now, they're living apart――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Je ne pense qu'a toi chaque jour! 
My beloved, today too,
I can't think of anything but you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's something that my father tells my mother
whenever they meet♪ It's wonderful,
isn't it? It's almost 
like he's saying "My heart is always with
you"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far apart,
they're always thinking of each other, 
and trust each other……The parents that I'm
proud of!

Seeing her smile like that made me happy as
well. 
That said, what she said and did earlier……
choice_data_list: You can't do this with just anyone...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah……Fufu, I'm sorry. 
I'll be careful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
This is my favorite cafe!
I wanted Trainer-san 
to try the French food here too.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'm looking forward to it!
Thanks, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.text:
Though I said that……the menu is very French
indeed. 
Honestly,
it all looks like gibberish to me……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what I should get today~. 
Maybe bourguignon?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what about――……Ooooh,
do you prefer delicacies? 
That section is almost all French food.
You've got quite the eye~!

I was initially intimidated when she pointed
that out 
but, that means it should be the best parts
of French cuisine.
I'll take it as a challenge and try it
out!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait~. 
This is the andouillette and the Roquefort
salad.

These delicacies were more impressive than
I expected……! 
A unique-looking sausage and blue cheese……I
couldn't help 
but feel lost when faced with unfamiliar
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah~ it looks delicious!
Thanks for the meal!

The moment I put the food in my mouth,
a very pungent scent 
assaulted my nose!
This is……incredibly……distinctive……!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ……Trainer-san? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waah, that's not good! 
I see,
maybe it was too much for a first-timer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But, it'll be fine!
Actually――For this unique andouillette, 
there's a special magic to make it
tastier!
choice_data_list: Eh, what is it……some kind of sauce?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Correct! That's right!
By eating it with this mustard sauce, 
it'll reduce the smell and make it easier
to scarf it down♪

I tried what she said――the mustard did a
good job masking 
the pungent scent……the taste was strong but
it was tasty!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Next I'll explain the salad~! 
First,
try eating one of those purple leaves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaa, isn't it~!? Now,
with that bitter taste in your mouth, 
what happens when you add a little bit of
that dressing~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right,
right!
The dressing here――is called a
vinaigrette, 
but, it goes best with Trevis leaves!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And the blue cheese on top is called Roquefort.
It has a strong 
salty taste that goes well with the salad,
so try a bite♪

Eating everything in the manner that Sakura
Laurel 
suggested made the meal delicious.
I think I understand 
why she prefers French cuisine now.
choice_data_list: French food is almost like magic
French food is almost like magic

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……That's right.
No matter what ingredients you have,
even if 
it's difficult to eat,
it's made in a way to make it delicious――
choice_data_list: Is what you're eating the same?
Is what you're eating the same?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! This is called 『Boeuf à la
Bourguignonne』. 
It's beef made from the tough meat in the
cheek, 
stewed in red win to make it tender.

It looks delicious. Next time we come here,
maybe I should 
try ordering that. So I don't forget,
I make a memo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――……Fufu. You're alike……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――Nope, I didn't♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
How about ordering some dessert? 
I've got some more recommendations♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today! 
Were you able to enjoy that quick tour of
France?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm glad! Let's do this together 
again sometime,
I'll be your guide then too♪

Today,
I learned alot about Sakura Laurel……more
and more, 
I wanted to lend my strength to her.
